notes.title: 3.2.16 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Sometimes, Alex would get stuck while climbing ladders, cliffs, or other objects around Edward’s Island. Now, climbing is possible. 

🔺Make sure to update before returning to Edward’s Island.

Thanks for your support tickets and help tracking down bugs. If you still have issues, please submit a new ticket on our support site: http://bit.ly/NSSsupport

notes.title: An Oxenfree update has Oxenfree 2 bleeding backwards in time
notes.notes:

notes.title: 3.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The latest OXENFREE patch addresses minor bugs. It also improves the radio system’s range and stability for tuning into broadcasts. Please report any unusual radio signals in the comments or by tuning your dial to 9🀰.◼︎

notes.title: 3.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Added macOS version for 3.0.x.
 Fixed issue where fog was too thick in some areas.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes: Things get a little dusty after five years. To spruce things up, we’ve made an update to OXENFREE! Now you’ll be able to point-and-click your way around Edwards Island with your mouse. We’ve also added 21:9 support for ultrawide monitors for the ultimate immersive ex[TENDED RANGE AND TIME WINDOW FOR RADIO BROADCAST RECEPTION]

notes.title: Free New Game Plus Update is Now Available
notes.notes:
LEAVE. IS. POSSIBLE.

That's right everyone, today is the day! Oxenfree's NewGame+ content is out now to all players for free. Every owner of the game should now be able to update Oxenfree and experience the continuation of Alex's story. The new mode will allow players to continue beyond the original “ending” into a new and exciting chapter of the game's story. We are incredibly excited to share all of this new content with you today, and can't wait to see what everyone thinks!

Thank you to all of you for supporting the game and our studio. We couldn't have done it without you!

notes.title: Update: 2 Weeks In
notes.notes:
Hello Oxenfree Community!

We at Night School Studio just wanted to take a moment and thank everyone here who has purchased and played Oxenfree these past 2 weeks. Its been an incredible experience seeing everyone enjoy this adventure we worked so hard to put together. 

We also want to make sure everyone is aware of the updates currently available for the game. We've already managed to fix several issues players have reported, and plan on continuing to support the game and it's community moving forward. Details on these updates can be found here.

Please ensure that you are on the most recent version (v1.3.1) before reporting any errors, and feel free to use the discussion threads for any questions and comments.
